cheapest.call_script: Bring up Solar Feed-in — a cost-leading option designed to reward your home's solar capacity.
cheapest.usage_narrative: Solar-capable household with generation potential that aligns well with feed-in reward plans.

green.call_script: Ask about EcoFlex — a renewable-backed plan well-suited to your home's eco-aligned profile.
green.usage_narrative: Eco-aligned household with moderate steady consumption suited to renewable energy plans.
